review_locator: PMCID:PMC7663688, Transcriptional regulation of inflammasomes; PMCID:PMC9454819, IRF8: Mechanism of Action and Health Implications
primary_title: PU.1 and IRF8 Modulate Activation of NLRP3 Inflammasome via Regulating Its Expression in Human Macrophages
decision_basis: The reviews identify a PU.1/IRF8 EICE mechanism for monocytic NLRP3 expression; the cited primary shows PU.1 and IRF8 occupancy at the human NLRP3 promoter and loss of NLRP3 expression and IL-1β release after either factor is knocked down.
limitations_preserved: Direct EICE occupancy, promoter mutagenesis and dual-knockdown effects support a bounded human monocytic IRF8/PU.1-to-NLRP3 gene bridge; preserve distal-promoter and LPS context and do not infer NLRP3 protein abundance beyond measured assays, inflammasome causality in SCI, or terminal-TF output.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6242948, Regulatory Networks Involving STATs, IRFs, and NFκB in Inflammation; PMCID:PMC9454819, IRF8: Mechanism of Action and Health Implications
primary_title: Phosphorylation of IRF8 in a pre-associated complex with Spi-1/PU.1 and non-phosphorylated Stat1 is critical for LPS induction of the IL1B gene
decision_basis: The reviews identify a poised IRF8/PU.1/STAT1 complex at the LPS and IL-1 response element; the cited primary shows constitutive occupancy by IRF8, PU.1 and non-tyrosine-phosphorylated STAT1 and mutation-sensitive LPS-induced IL1B promoter activity.
limitations_preserved: Mutation-sensitive promoter activity and constitutive complex occupancy support a bounded human myeloid IL1B gene bridge; preserve non-tyrosine-phosphorylated STAT1 and adjacent C/EBPβ/LPS context, without inferring IL-1β maturation/secretion, SCI effects, or terminal-TF output.
